checks.finding: (1) Venetian’s COTE page badges 'One MICHELIN Star' (NYC/Miami), whereas the 2026 Southwest Guide lists COTE Las Vegas as Recommended; official PDF prints $95/$225 pp. (2) Neon Museum’s Visit FAQ states that starting January 1, 2027, arriving earlier or later than your selected ticket time may require paying a higher ticket-price difference prior to entry. (3) Crockfords moved from /hotels/crockfords/ (HTTP 500) to /stay/crockfords-las-vegas/ (HTTP 200). (4) RTC publishes no Visitor 7-Day Strip & All Access pass ($20 7-Day is Residential); 2 × 3-Day ($40) + 1 × 24-Hour ($8) = $48/person ($96/couple) covers 168 hours across all routes vs $120/couple for 6 × 3-Day passes.
